abi: event Claimed(uint256 indexed depositId, address indexed to, uint256 amount, uint256 fee)
event Funded(uint256 indexed depositId, address indexed funder, address indexed token, uint256 amount, address verifier, bytes32 constraint, uint64 refundWindow, uint16 feeBps, bytes32 ref)
event OwnerRefreshed(address indexed verifier, address indexed owner, uint64 iat)
event Refunded(uint256 indexed depositId, address indexed funder, address indexed token, uint256 amount)
event Swept(address indexed verifier, address indexed token, uint256 amount, uint256 fee, address indexed to, uint256 depositsConsumed)
event SweptBucket(address indexed verifier, bytes32 indexed constraint, address indexed token, uint256 amount, uint256 fee, address to, uint256 depositsConsumed)
function acceptOwnerProof(address verifier, address wallet, uint64 iat) returns (bytes4)
function bucketCursor(address verifier, bytes32 constraint, address token) view returns (uint256)
function bucketDepositCount(address verifier, bytes32 constraint, address token) view returns (uint256)
function bucketDepositIds(address verifier, bytes32 constraint, address token, uint256 offset, uint256 limit) view returns (uint256[] ids)
function bucketTotal(address verifier, bytes32 constraint, address token) view returns (uint256)
function constraintDeposit(bytes32 constraint, address funder) view returns (bool used, uint256 depositId)
function deposits(uint256) view returns (address funder, uint64 fundedAt, bool consumed, address token, uint64 refundWindow, address verifier, uint16 feeBps, uint128 amount, bytes32 constraint)
function fund(address token, uint256 amount, bytes32 constraint, uint64 refundWindow, bytes32 ref) payable returns (uint256 depositId)
function fundFor(address funder, address verifier, address token, uint256 amount, bytes32 constraint, uint64 refundWindow, bytes32 ref) payable returns (uint256 depositId)
function fundWith(address verifier, address token, uint256 amount, bytes32 constraint, uint64 refundWindow, bytes32 ref) payable returns (uint256 depositId)
function refreshProofAndSweep(address verifier, bytes proof, address token, uint256 depositCountLimit) returns (uint256 amount, uint256 consumed)
function sweep(address verifier, address token, uint256 depositCountLimit) returns (uint256 amount, uint256 consumed)
function sweepBucket(address verifier, (bytes32 commitment, bytes signature) constraint, address token, bytes proof, uint256 depositCountLimit) returns (uint256 amount, uint256 consumed)
function sweepBucketDeposits(address verifier, (bytes32 commitment, bytes signature) constraint, address token, uint256[] depositIds, bytes proof) returns (uint256 amount)
function sweepDeposits(address verifier, address token, uint256[] depositIds) returns (uint256 amount)
function sweepable(address verifier, address token) view returns (uint256)
